content.text:
The crate was already in fairly good shape, so I made four small cleanups. All tests pass and clippy reports no warnings. I didn't touch the larger functions, such as `send_message` in `src/broker/message_commands.rs`, to keep the diff low-risk.

1. **`9a168f9`**: The visibility-timeout and delay ranges (`0..=43_200`, `0..=900`) were repeated as literals in `src/attributes.rs` and `src/broker/message_commands.rs`. They are now named constants defined once in `src/attributes.rs`.
2. **`b67bf61`**: The `MissingParameter` error was formatted separately in `src/request.rs` and `src/broker/message_commands.rs`. Both now call `missing_parameter` in `src/request.rs`.
3. **`dffd086`**: `CreateQueue` and `SetQueueAttributes` each had their own copy of the rule that `ContentBasedDeduplication` needs a FIFO queue. It is now one method on `AttributeUpdate`.
4. **`3bd077a`**: In `Queue::expire`, the expiry closure was built before the early-return guard. It now comes after.

The first commit was briefly broken: my chained command committed even though the build had failed. I amended it before continuing, so all four commits build.

I left the repeated `params.require(...)` followed by `.expect("required")` pattern alone. It follows the check order in SPEC section 2, and changing it adds more than it removes.

The crate was already in fairly good shape, so I made four small cleanups. All tests pass and clippy reports no warnings. I didn't touch the larger functions, such as `send_message` in `src/broker/message_commands.rs`, to keep the diff low-risk.

1. **`9a168f9`**: The visibility-timeout and delay ranges (`0..=43_200`, `0..=900`) were repeated as literals in `src/attributes.rs` and `src/broker/message_commands.rs`. They are now named constants defined once in `src/attributes.rs`.
2. **`b67bf61`**: The `MissingParameter` error was formatted separately in `src/request.rs` and `src/broker/message_commands.rs`. Both now call `missing_parameter` in `src/request.rs`.
3. **`dffd086`**: `CreateQueue` and `SetQueueAttributes` each had their own copy of the rule that `ContentBasedDeduplication` needs a FIFO queue. It is now one method on `AttributeUpdate`.
4. **`3bd077a`**: In `Queue::expire`, the expiry closure was built before the early-return guard. It now comes after.

The first commit was briefly broken: my chained command committed even though the build had failed. I amended it before continuing, so all four commits build.

I left the repeated `params.require(...)` followed by `.expect("required")` pattern alone. It follows the check order in SPEC section 2, and changing it adds more than it removes.
